Interface NoteService

public interface NoteService

  • Method Details

    • createNote

      NoteResponse createNote(NoteRequest request)
      Creates and persists a new journal note linked to a valid course.
      Parameters:
      request - the validated note creation payload
      Returns:
      the persisted note response
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if the specified course does not exist

    • listNotes

      List<NoteResponse> listNotes(Long courseId)
      Retrieves all notes for a course ordered by creation timestamp descending.
      Parameters:
      courseId - the course ID to filter by
      Returns:
      list of note responses, newest first
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if the specified course does not exist

    • getNote

      NoteResponse getNote(UUID id)
      Retrieves a single note by its unique identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique UUID of the note
      Returns:
      the note response
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if no note exists with the given identifier

    • updateNote

      NoteResponse updateNote(UUID id, NoteRequest request)
      Fully updates the content of an existing note.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique UUID of the note to update
      request - the replacement note payload
      Returns:
      the updated note response
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if the note or course does not exist

    • updateImageMetadata

      NoteResponse updateImageMetadata(UUID id, ImageMetadataUpdateRequest request)
      Selectively updates the image metadata of an existing note while preserving its markdown text. Verifies that all metadata keys correspond to existing image references in the markdown.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique UUID of the note to update
      request - the image metadata update payload
      Returns:
      the updated note response
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if the note does not exist
      BadRequestException - if the updated metadata keys do not match existing markdown image references

    • deleteNote

      void deleteNote(UUID id)
      Deletes a note by its unique identifier. Associated AI-extracted records are not cascade-deleted.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique UUID of the note to delete
      Throws:
      ResourceNotFoundException - if no note exists with the given identifier
